title: SwitchControl 1.0.8 — Official Release
headline: Pre-launch credibility hardening: honest telemetry display, strengthened auth, crash-proof startup, and security guardrails across the stack.
changes: JWT startup no longer crashes on missing secrets — graceful skip with clear logging
Removed all hardcoded fake demo values from UI (FPS claims, service counts, rotating taglines)
WebSocket telemetry now requires authenticated upgrades with reconnect storm protection
System intelligence refresh rate-limited to 1 per 5 minutes per user
Stripe event cleanup runs automatically (30-day retention)
Health endpoint reports DB status, version, and uptime
Electron installer builds cleanly even without optional Rust memory cleaner
Fixed stray syntax errors in main.js that blocked app launch
Apply Safe guard expanded with strict deny-list and category filters
